title: Step 4 - Visualizing Decision Tree: Understanding Intervals and Predictions

cues.en: Instructor: And now let's check it out.
cues.zh: 現在來檢查。

cues.en: The model is actually ready.
cues.zh: 模型其實準備好了。

cues.en: We can actually replace that by decision tree regression.
cues.zh: 將標題換成 Decision Tree Regression。

cues.en: And now let's check it out and you will see what the real decision tree regression model looks like in one D.
cues.zh: 再看看一維情況下，真正的決策樹迴歸長什麼樣。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's select all this and execute.
cues.zh: 選取全部並執行。

cues.en: And here it is.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: That's what it looks like.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: And actually, since it's a non continuous model we should even have some strictly vertical line here.
cues.zh: 因為模型不連續，這裡甚至應該是完全垂直的線，

cues.en: You know, to, represent better than non continuity.
cues.zh: 才能更清楚呈現不連續性。

cues.en: And to do this, we just need to increase the resolution.
cues.zh: 只需提高解析度。

cues.en: So I'm gonna put 0.01 and you'll see that we'll get the real representation of the decision tree regression results.
cues.zh: 我設為 0.01，你會看到真正的決策樹迴歸結果。

cues.en: So let's do it, here it is now almost vertical and that's a clear representation of the decision tree regression model.
cues.zh: 執行後，線幾乎垂直，清楚呈現模型形狀。

cues.en: So now let's zoom on it.
cues.zh: 現在放大。

cues.en: And now it makes much more sense because as Carol explained based on the entropy and the information gain it splits the whole range of your independent variable into different intervals.
cues.zh: 合理多了。正如 Kirill 解釋的，演算法依資訊熵與資訊增益，將自變數的整個值域切成不同區間。

cues.en: So here we can clearly see where the intervals are.
cues.zh: 這裡能清楚看到區間。

cues.en: The first interval is from one to 6.5.
cues.zh: 第一段從 1 到 6.5。

cues.en: The second interval is from 6.5 to 8.5.
cues.zh: 第二段從 6.5 到 8.5。

cues.en: Then the third interval is from 8.5 to 9.5.
cues.zh: 第三段從 8.5 到 9.5。

cues.en: And finally, the last interval is from 9.5 to 10.
cues.zh: 最後一段從 9.5 到 10。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: We can clearly see the intervals now.
cues.zh: 現在區間非常清楚。

cues.en: And as Carol explained in the intuition tutorial, the decision tree regression model is considering the average of the dependent variable values in each of the intervals.
cues.zh: 如直覺教學所說，模型會計算每個區間內應變數的平均。

cues.en: This one, this one, this one, and this one.
cues.zh: 包括這四個區間。

cues.en: So for example, if we consider this interval here the average of the salaries in this interval well that's very simple.
cues.zh: 例如這個區間，薪資的平均很簡單，

cues.en: It's actually 250,000.
And so for each of the level between 6.5 and 8.5 the salaries will be predicted to be $250,000.
cues.zh: 所以 6.5 到 8.5 間的每個職等，都預測為 250,000 美元。

cues.en: So we already know what our model will predict.
cues.zh: 因此我們已知道模型會預測什麼。

cues.en: For our 6.5 level here, it's going to predict 250 K.
cues.zh: 職等 6.5，會預測為 250K。

cues.en: So speaking of this prediction and now that we get the decision tree regression graphic results very well let's actually check that the previous salary of this employee that had a 6.5 level
cues.zh: 現在圖形很清楚，來確認這位前公司職等 6.5 的員工，其預測過去薪資

cues.en: in its previous company is actually 250 K.
cues.zh: 是否確實為 250K。

cues.en: Let's check it out.
cues.zh: 檢查一下。

cues.en: Let's select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行。

cues.en: And here it is, 250,000 exactly like we predicted because we can clearly see that on this plot.
cues.zh: 果然是 250,000，和我們看圖預期的一樣。

cues.en: So now I just wanna say two things to conclude.
cues.zh: 最後說兩件事。

cues.en: The decision tree regression model is not an interesting model in one D but it can be a very interesting and very powerful model in more dimensions.
cues.zh: 決策樹迴歸在一維裡不太有意思，但在更高維度可能非常有趣、強大。

cues.en: So that's why you can use this code here for your datasets.
cues.zh: 所以可以將這份程式用於自己的資料集。

cues.en: You have the code here that builds the model and this one here that makes the prediction.
cues.zh: 這段建立模型，這段進行預測。

cues.en: But then you won't be able to use this code because you'll have probably a lot of independent variables and therefore a lot of dimensions.
cues.zh: 但繪圖程式可能無法使用，因為通常會有很多自變數，也就很多維度。

cues.en: But you know, Carol gave you the explanation in two D, I'm giving you the explanation of one D so that now in your mind, you can perfectly represent in your head the decision tree regression and how it works.
cues.zh: Kirill 用二維解釋，我用一維解釋，希望讓你能在腦中清楚想像決策樹迴歸如何運作。

cues.en: And now I would like to end this tutorial by an enigma.
cues.zh: 最後留個問題。

cues.en: In the next section you will see random forests.
cues.zh: 下一節會學隨機森林。

cues.en: And a random forest is actually really simple.
cues.zh: 隨機森林其實非常簡單。

cues.en: It's just a team of several decision trees.
cues.zh: 就是多棵決策樹組成的團隊。

cues.en: So knowing that this is the result of one tree what do you think we'll get with a team of 10 trees or even a hundred trees or 500 trees?
cues.zh: 既然這是一棵樹的結果，你覺得 10 棵、100 棵，甚至 500 棵樹會得到什麼？

cues.en: The first question is do you think we'll get this shape of some stairs here?
cues.zh: 第一個問題，還會是這種階梯形狀嗎？

cues.en: And the second question is do you think we'll get a much more accurate prediction, like a prediction that is getting very close to the 160 K that is supposed to be the real salary?
cues.zh: 第二個問題，預測是否會更準確，更接近他聲稱的實際薪資 160K？

cues.en: So these are the two questions.
cues.zh: 就是這兩個問題。

cues.en: I will let you think about that and I look forward to giving you the solution in the next section.
cues.zh: 先想想，下一節我會提供解答。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
